review_findings.reason: create_order_from_cart() had no idempotency and no locking, allowing two concurrent/retried checkouts to both create a full order for the same cart before either cleared it.
markSucceeded() was called on every successful checkout, excluding successful orders from the rate-limit window and allowing unlimited valid-order spam.
The dish_variants is_available exemption used an explicit column allow-list that would fail open for any future dish_variants column.
The order-status page's aria-live region was on a fully static server-rendered page with no update mechanism -- decorative, not a real announcement.
No automated a11y tests existed for the three new customer-facing pages (cart, checkout, order-status).

orders.total_cents/currency/fulfillment_type/guest_access_token_hash/cart_id were freely updatable by service_role with no guard, a payment-safety hazard given Epic 7 will treat total_cents as the charge amount.
No test asserted the anon/authenticated deny-by-default RLS posture on the seven new tables.

review_findings.area: tenant context on the status page (#22)
review_findings.reason: The order-status page never verified the resolved order's tenant matched the route [slug].
readOrderAccessToken() was unused and its docstring described unimplemented behavior.

required_actions: Fix the duplicate-order race in create_order_from_cart (row lock + idempotency constraint) and add a concurrent-checkout integration test.
Make the checkout rate limit count successful checkouts.
Rewrite the dish_variants publish-guard exemption to be column-set agnostic and add the negative test.
Add axe a11y tests for the cart, checkout and order-status pages; implement a real status-change announcement on the order-status page.
Guard the immutable columns of orders against app-facing UPDATE.
Add anon/authenticated deny-by-default assertions for the seven new tables.
Resolve the low-severity items or record explicit deferrals.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Finding 1 (HIGH): duplicate-order race in create_order_from_cart is closed
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 20260804090000_orders_state_machine_and_checkout.sql: `for update` row lock is the first statement on the cart lookup, before readiness checks and the INSERT. Partial unique index orders_one_active_per_cart_idx (cart_id) where cart_id is not null and status <> 'cancelled'. INSERT wrapped in exception handler mapping unique_violation to a clear error. 10-parallel-connection concurrency test (pg Pool, Promise.all) asserts exactly 1 order created, 9 rejections, none leaking a raw duplicate-key message.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Finding 2 (medium): successful checkouts count toward the rate limit
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No markSucceeded() call remains in checkout/actions.ts; tests assert it's never called on success and that the limit blocks after accumulated successful attempts.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Finding 3 (medium): dish_variants publish-guard exemption is column-set agnostic
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Row-diff via to_jsonb(new) - 'is_available' - 'updated_at' = to_jsonb(old) - ... nested correctly inside the dish_variants/UPDATE-only branch. Negative test proves a bundled content change is still rejected.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Finding 4 (medium): payment-critical orders columns are immutable for app-facing roles
acceptance_criteria.evidence: guard_orders_payment_fields_change() locks total_cents/currency/fulfillment_type/guest_access_token_hash/cart_id for authenticated/anon/service_role; customer-detail fields and the sanctioned status flag remain mutable. Test run as service_role proves both the rejection and the still-allowed cases.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Finding 5 (medium): aria-live region has a real update mechanism
acceptance_criteria.evidence: order-status-live.tsx client component polls a server action every ~20s, updates only on status change, stops on terminal status, cleans up its interval on unmount. Component test coverage included.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Finding 6 (medium): automated a11y coverage for cart/checkout/order-status
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cart-page-design.a11y.test.ts, checkout-page-design.a11y.test.ts, order-status-page-design.a11y.test.ts use real contrast math (incl. alpha-compositing for translucent overlays) plus semantic-structure RTL tests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Finding 7 (low): order-status page verifies tenant slug
acceptance_criteria.evidence: get_order_status_by_token now returns tenantSlug (never tenant_id); page and server action both compare it to the route slug and render the identical generic not-found state on mismatch.
Function removed; repo-wide grep confirms zero remaining references.
Four repair commits touch only the files implicated by the eight findings plus their tests; no unrelated refactors.

review_findings.reason: orders.cart_id is ON DELETE SET NULL, but guard_orders_payment_fields_change() rejects any cart_id change for app-facing roles -- a future service_role-initiated cart-pruning DELETE would fail once it touches an order-linked cart. Latent, not currently reachable (no pruning job exists yet).
review_findings.required_correction: When cart pruning/TTL is implemented, exempt the null-transition or run pruning on a non-app-facing connection. Record on the pruning ticket.

review_findings.reason: The unique_violation handler in create_order_from_cart maps every violation (including a theoretical guest_access_token_hash collision) to the same 'already checked out' message. Not realistically reachable given 256-bit token randomness.
review_findings.required_correction: Optional/deferrable: discriminate on constraint name if tightened later.

review_findings.reason: OrderStatusLive's polling has no .catch(), so a transient poll failure produces an unhandled promise rejection every ~20s (display stays correct, polling continues).

residual_risks: pollOrderStatus is an unauthenticated, unrate-limited server action -- same exposure as the page GET it mirrors, token is 256-bit random, but worth rate-limiting if the projection grows richer.
No Playwright/E2E coverage for cart -> checkout -> order-status; a11y coverage is unit-level rather than axe-on-rendered-page (pre-existing repo-wide gap).
is_valid_order_status_transition() (SQL) and packages/domain/src/orders/state-machine.ts are hand-maintained mirrors with no automated cross-check; Epic 7's webhook-driven transition must touch both.
orders.tax_rate_snapshot is a hardcoded 0 placeholder; must be resolved before any real (non-test-mode) charge.
The cart FK / payment-guard interaction above will surface the first time a cart-pruning job is written.
